summary.text: David Martin is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 68 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
David Martin's general-election opponents are Matt Schlinker (D), Deanna Martin (L), and Joe McHugh (Independent).
He served in the U.S. Air Force and chairs the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation Committee.

paragraphs.text: David Martin was born in Detroit, Michigan, and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1979 to 1999.

He earned an associate degree from Keiser University in 2012, and his career experience includes working as a veteran services coordinator with Mott Community College, director of contract security services with the Pontiac Silverdome, and an executive.
He has been affiliated with the Davison American Legion Post #267, the Michigan Masons, the Air Force Association, and the National Rifle Association.

Martin assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and in 2025-2026 chairs the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation Committee and also serves on the Energy, Financial Services, and Rules and Competitiveness committees.
